summary: Configures a multiplayer session mode: maps the session-type argument a2 onto a mode value stored at this+0xB6C, then initializes four session-slot entries starting at this+0x1EC (stride 0x128) to -1 (invalid). Session-type cases 4, 5 and 6 map to mode values 1, 2 and 3; cases 1, 2 and 3 all map to mode 0; the default case stores a2 itself as the mode. Called from sub_4F18C0 on the frame path.

operations.description: Clear the session mode field at this+0xB6C to 0 before the switch.
Session-type cases 4, 5 and 6 set the mode field at this+0xB6C to 1, 2 and 3 respectively.
Session-type cases 1, 2 and 3 all reset the mode field at this+0xB6C back to 0.
Default case: store the session-type argument a2 itself as the mode value at this+0xB6C.
Initialize 4 session-slot entries starting at this+0x1EC with a 74-dword (0x128 byte) stride, writing -1 into each.
Return the cursor register after the loop (points at this+0x1EC, one stride past the last slot).
